summary: Two intersection cameras (313, 314) at Oxford St/Flinders St, Taylor Square: both changed detection level overnight on 29 Aug 2024 and 7 Nov 2024 (together 3-6x in most zones) while a nearby piezo stayed flat, so every direction is split into separate series at those dates. Camera 313 undercounted several zones on 29 Oct-4 Nov 2024 (set missing), and the Flinders St east footpath (436), and to a lesser degree zones 432 and 434, show recurring false-detection bursts of hundreds per slot that are set missing day by day; the Jul-Aug 2025 dips and the 2025 shifts between Oxford St zones look like weather and roadworks and are kept.
